subject: maths
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

learningObjectives.title: Number: operations, fractions, decimals and percentages
Ratio, proportion and rates of change
Powers, roots, indices and standard form

questions.q: What is the highest common factor (HCF) of 24 and 36?
questions.explain: The largest number that divides exactly into both 24 and 36 is 12.

questions.q: Which of these numbers is a prime number?
questions.explain: 53 has no factors other than 1 and itself, whereas 51 = 3 x 17, 57 = 3 x 19 and 49 = 7 x 7.

questions.q: Write the decimal 0.375 as a fraction in its lowest terms.
questions.explain: 0.375 = 375/1000, which simplifies to 3/8 by dividing top and bottom by 125.

questions.q: The recurring decimal 0.3333... is equal to which fraction?
questions.explain: One third written as a decimal gives the recurring value 0.3333...

questions.q: A jacket costs £80. Its price is increased by 15%. What is the new price?
questions.explain: 15% of £80 is £12, so the new price is £80 + £12 = £92.

questions.q: After a 20% reduction, a coat costs £48. What was its original price?
questions.explain: £48 represents 80% of the original, so the original is £48 divided by 0.8 = £60.

questions.q: £60 is shared between two people in the ratio 2 : 3. How much does each person receive?
questions.explain: There are 5 parts of £12, giving 2 x £12 = £24 and 3 x £12 = £36.

questions.q: 5 identical pens cost £2. Assuming direct proportion, what do 8 of the pens cost?
questions.explain: One pen costs £0.40, so 8 pens cost 8 x £0.40 = £3.20.

questions.q: A car travels 150 km in 2 hours. What is its average speed?
questions.explain: Average speed = distance divided by time = 150 divided by 2 = 75 km/h.

questions.q: What is the value of 2 to the power 0?
questions.explain: Any non-zero number raised to the power 0 equals 1.

questions.q: Simplify 3^2 x 3^4.
questions.explain: When multiplying powers of the same base, add the indices: 2 + 4 = 6.

questions.q: Write 45 000 in standard form.
questions.explain: Standard form requires a number between 1 and 10, and 4.5 x 10^4 = 45 000.

questions.q: What is the value of 5^-2?
questions.explain: A negative index gives the reciprocal, so 5^-2 = 1 divided by 5^2 = 1/25.

questions.q: Work out (2 x 10^3) x (4 x 10^2), giving your answer in standard form.
questions.explain: Multiply the numbers (2 x 4 = 8) and add the indices (3 + 2 = 5) to get 8 x 10^5.

questions.q: Expand the brackets: 3(x + 2).
questions.explain: Multiply each term inside the bracket by 3 to get 3x + 6.

questions.q: Solve the equation 2x + 5 = 13.
questions.explain: Subtract 5 to get 2x = 8, then divide by 2 to give x = 4.

questions.q: Factorise x^2 + 5x + 6.
questions.explain: The two numbers that multiply to 6 and add to 5 are 2 and 3.

questions.q: What is the nth term of the sequence 3, 5, 7, 9, ...?
questions.explain: The common difference is 2 and 2(1) + 1 = 3, so the nth term is 2n + 1.

questions.q: What is the gradient of the line y = 3x - 2?
questions.explain: In the form y = mx + c the gradient is m, which is 3 here.

questions.q: Rearrange y = 2x + 4 to make x the subject.
questions.explain: Subtract 4 from both sides then divide by 2 to give x = (y - 4)/2.
